description: This file contains utility methods related to Android platform version checks and enabling strict mode for debugging purposes within an Android contacts application.

classes.name: Utils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for platform version checking and enabling strict mode in an Android application.

methods.name: enableStrictMode
methods.description: Enables strict mode policies if the device runs Gingerbread or later, with additional features for Honeycomb.

methods.name: hasGingerbread
methods.description: Checks if the device's platform version is Gingerbread (API level 9) or higher.

methods.name: hasHoneycomb
methods.description: Checks if the device's platform version is Honeycomb (API level 11) or higher.

methods.name: hasHoneycombMR1
methods.description: Checks if the device's platform version is Honeycomb MR1 (API level 12) or higher.

methods.name: hasICS
methods.description: Checks if the device's platform version is Ice Cream Sandwich (API level 14) or higher.
